info.name: AMS Travel Mobile
info.description: The AMS Travel API as the mobile app uses it, one folder per screen. Built by docs/mobile/postman/build-collection.py from the API's OpenAPI description on 2026-10-14. Reads marked public need no token; the rest send the traveller's bearer token from {{token}}. See docs/mobile/screens-to-api.md for what each screen needs.

item.name: Get a traveller token (password grant, testing shortcut)

exec: if (body.access_token) { pm.environment.set('token', body.access_token); pm.test('token stored in the environment', () => true); }

request.description: Testing shortcut only: the app itself signs in through Keycloak's pages with the public client amstravel-mobile (PKCE). Fill username and password in the environment; the test script stores the token for every other request.
